STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: rtlpp_05296_combined.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: rtlpp_05296_combined.v · Open raw
module rtlpp_05296(
    input clk,
    input rst_n,
    
    input cpu_start,
    input quit_cmd,
    
    output stall,
    output stall_1shot,
    output reg stall_dly,
    output reg rst_pipe,
    output reg rst_pipe_id,
    output reg rst_pipe_ex,
    output reg rst_pipe_ma,
    output reg rst_pipe_wb
);

reg cpu_run_state;

always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n)
        cpu_run_state <= 1'b0;
    else if (quit_cmd)
        cpu_run_state <= 1'b0;   
    else if (cpu_start)
        cpu_run_state <= 1'b1;
end

assign stall = ~cpu_run_state;

always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n)
        stall_dly <= 1'b1 ;
    else
        stall_dly <= stall;
end

assign stall_1shot = stall & ~stall_dly;

wire start_reset = cpu_start & ~cpu_run_state;
wire end_reset = quit_cmd & cpu_run_state;

always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n)
        rst_pipe <= 1'b0 ;
    else
        rst_pipe <= start_reset | end_reset;
end

always @ (posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
    if (~rst_n) begin
        rst_pipe_id <= 1'b0 ;
        rst_pipe_ex <= 1'b0 ;
        rst_pipe_ma <= 1'b0 ;
        rst_pipe_wb <= 1'b0 ;
    end
    else begin
        rst_pipe_id <= rst_pipe;
        rst_pipe_ex <= rst_pipe_id;
        rst_pipe_ma <= rst_pipe_ex;
        rst_pipe_wb <= rst_pipe_ma;
    end
end

endmodule
